title: TCP/IP Receive
text: Receive data over TCP/IP network from specified remote machine, 2 outputs, {Terminator} sets Terminator; {Remote address} sets the remote host name or address remote host name or IP, {Port} sets the remote host port, {Verify address and port connectivity} sets the remote machine connection verification, {Data size} sets the number of values read, {Source Data type} sets the output data type, {ASCII format string} sets the format of string, {Custom Terminator} sets the custom terminator numeric array, {Byte order} sets the sequential order, {Enable blocking mode} sets the simulation waits while receiving data, {Timeout} sets the allowed time to complete operations and {Block sample time} sets the sampling time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Remote address
params.values: Remote host name or address remote host name or IP address

params.name: Port
params.values: Remote host port 80 (default) | remote host port

params.name: Data size
params.values: Number of values read [1,1] (default) | numeric array

params.name: Source Data type
params.values: Output data type uint8 (default) | single | double | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | ASCII

params.name: ASCII format string
params.values: Format of string data %f (default) | numeric conversion specifiers

params.name: Terminator
params.values: Terminator LF (default) | CR | CR/LF | LF/CR | Custom terminator

params.name: Custom Terminator
params.values: Custom terminator numeric array | integer from 0 to 255

params.name: Byte order
params.values: Sequential order of bytes big-endian (default) | little-endian

params.name: Enable blocking mode
params.values: Simulation waits while receiving data on (default) | off

params.name: Timeout
params.values: Allowed time to complete operations 10 (default) | positive scalar
